prompts.task: Create ./service/.observe and copy ./service/eval/inputs/otel-audit.json to ./service/.observe/otel-audit.json. Validate it and render its audit HTML once before selection; keep ordinary findings directly under Findings and only tagged AO findings in the nested Splunk Agent Observability subsection. Use the bundled selection flow to request OTEL-002 and AO-003. Respect the dependency-closed scope, then instrument the AI assistant FastAPI service for the bounded app-owned GenAI lifecycle, preserve the search_docs tool operation while adding its selected nested retrieval operation, resolve the project and Agent Stream resources where authorized, and persist direct Splunk Agent Observability trace routing so the deployed app does not require Obstudio in its runtime path. Report an exact access blocker rather than inventing resource IDs if resources cannot be resolved. Write and validate bound canonical selection and instrumentation JSON for the selected audit scope, then render compatibility Markdown and the self-contained instrumentation HTML without rewriting the audit HTML. Add focused tests and run verification where practical.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service for changed files, tests, canonical audit/selection/instrumentation JSON, and generated .observe reader output when present.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric: Adds one reusable OpenTelemetry setup path and avoids duplicate SDK initialization.
Instruments FastAPI plus app-owned assistant turn, provider/model call, tool execution, streaming lifecycle, token/context pressure, and feedback export surfaces.
Uses OTel GenAI semantic-convention names where data is available, including gen_ai operation/model/provider attributes and token usage metrics.

Preserves exactly one execute_tool search_docs span and adds exactly one nested retrieval demo-knowledge-base span as its direct child, with gen_ai.operation.name=retrieval and stable gen_ai.data_source.id=demo-knowledge-base, while recording no raw retrieval query or document content.

Adds focused runtime telemetry proof for the search_docs path that asserts exactly one tool span, exactly one retrieval child span, their parent-child IDs, required retrieval attributes, and absence of gen_ai.retrieval.query.text and gen_ai.retrieval.documents.
Handles partial token-pressure closure honestly by naming remaining truncation, token-limit, prompt/tool schema size, or fanout signals when not implemented.
Adds or updates tests or compile checks and keeps raw prompts, completions, sessions, users, tenants, requests, and tool arguments out of metric dimensions.
Writes bound canonical .observe/otel-selection.json and .observe/otel-instrumentation.json for the selected audit scope without rewriting the audit baseline.

Records OTEL-002 and AO-003 as the explicit requests and automatically includes their executable OTEL-001, AO-001, and AO-002 prerequisites in canonical audit order; preserves finding_group only for the Splunk Agent Observability findings and does not add an opentelemetry group to ordinary findings; implements and reports every dependency-closed finding exactly once while leaving unselected work untouched.

Keeps the project resource, Agent Stream resource, and direct routing as three distinct outcomes: resolves or creates each real resource only when authorized, reports an exact access blocker rather than inventing IDs otherwise, and leaves durable direct application/deployment routing with operator-owned secret references so Obstudio is not required at runtime. None is represented as invented span or metric telemetry.

Renders compatibility Markdown and the separate self-contained instrumentation HTML without rewriting the audit HTML; the preexisting audit reader keeps ordinary OTel finding cards directly under Findings while nesting its tagged AO findings under the Splunk Agent Observability subsection. Required cards remain ahead of recommended cards, and AO card detail headings remain subordinate to the subsection heading without changing the ordinary OTel card detail hierarchy.
Runs otel-verify and produces reader-first What Changed, Tested And Working, Not Working Or Not Proven, and Proof results, or records an exact blocker and keeps the instrumentation result Partial.
